title: Native TermAl pair-mailbox: supersedes metadata, sender-visible turn state, doorbell collapse
outcome: The Sol+Fable dev-team pattern (docs/dev-team-pattern.md §3) runs on batched cross-session messages, which produced measurable noise in practice: during the tm-drd collaboration, five crossed/echoed completion messages arrived out of order because content lives in the queue and rots while the receiver is mid-turn. We now run a file-based workaround (.collab/ mailbox: per-agent outboxes, sequence-numbered immutable messages with Stamp/Type/Supersedes headers, content-free "mbx NNNN" doorbell messages, per-reader cursors — see .collab/PROTOCOL.md). This bead tracks building the doc §3 infrastructure wishlist into TermAl natively so the convention stops being convention: (1) message metadata (topic, supersedes) that auto-collapses superseded queue entries before delivery; (2) sender-visible receiver turn state ("mid-turn, N queued") on termal_send_to_session; (3) a first-class per-pair mailbox with an index instead of a scratch directory; (4) a real interrupt flag for round-invalidating events, replacing the session-preview one-liner hack. Success criterion: two collaborating sessions can exchange a multi-round work cycle with zero duplicate/echo messages and zero stale-imperative executions.
